recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future formal binding value set for contextDirection or additional direction modes should be handled by a new or explicitly confirmed Vocab tracker, not by reopening FHIR-17321.
issue_request: FHIR-17321 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab STU3 change request to support different value sets for incoming versus outgoing use by adding a ValueSet.$expand parameter. The approved resolution was to use the existing context parameter and add contextDirection for incoming and outgoing.
initial_application: The Jira comment recorded svn revision 14031. The matching git-svn commit c2bc0211921c8f7bbac3abeb6645aba6788402e2 explicitly says GF#17321 defined ValueSet.$expand.contextDirection and added expand.contextDirection to the ValueSet operation spreadsheet. Later commit 66ae1e40f1bc02283363c872db14035fc795f8f7 reformatted the same values for FHIR-18047, and later source refactoring preserved the parameter in the standalone OperationDefinition XML.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ValueSet as an active resource and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/ValueSet-expand. The linked Zulip discussion confirms the Clinical Notes incoming/outgoing use case and the creation of GF17321; a later terminology Zulip thread discusses implementation. FHIR-18047 is already audited on the combined branch, and FHIR-24834 later proposed but retracted adding contextDirection=existing.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml already defines contextDirection as a 0..1 input code parameter immediately after context and documents incoming for PUT/POST codes and outgoing for codes a client might receive.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive issue highlighted contextDirection values as a bullet list and is already represented on the combined branch.

Later proposal to add contextDirection=existing was Resolved - No Change/Retracted, supporting no additional source change here.
